astrometric_solution_binding.reason: source_calib contains solution_num. Pooling all solutions belonging to a scan can mix different astrometric solution footprints and is forbidden in the corrected search.
astrometric_solution_binding.rule: Each v094h exposure is already bound to one selected solution_id and scan_id. Resolve the corresponding solution_num from the frozen v094d solution_full table. Source acquisition and source-state analysis are keyed by the exact (scan_id, solution_num), never scan_id alone.

common_footprint.definition: For each v094h opportunity, source rows must lie inside both of the exact STC polygons associated with the two selected solution_id values. This is the same sky-overlap population semantics used by v094h, applied at source level.

known_population_context_at_freeze.dominant_site_pair: Dr. Remeis-Observatory, Bamberg, Germany | Hamburg-Bergedorf, Germany

population.gate: gate_le5min == true; includes positive fragment overlap and >0 to <=300 s fragment gap

result_output_privacy.allowed: counts, rates, fixed separation bins, opportunity-level aggregates, site-pair aggregates, timing/epoch aggregates

scientific_role: First corrected source-level pass over the fresh v094h denominator. Process every <=5 minute distinct-site opportunity, while preventing the v094c scan/solution mixing and unqualified-control pathologies from re-entering the pipeline.

batching.maxrec_hit: split; if one key still reaches MAXREC, explicit HOLD rather than truncate

source_acquisition.quality_gate_interpretation: This is the strict confirmatory high-quality source branch. It does not prove that lower-quality extractions are uninteresting; those remain a separately bankable sensitivity branch and are not silently counted as searched confirmatory sources.
source_acquisition.source_id_uniqueness: source_id is treated as unique within an exact (scan_id,solution_num) product. Any duplicate source_id in a returned exact-key product is an explicit provenance/data HOLD; do not silently deduplicate.
source_acquisition.working_cache: Raw VOTables and per-(scan_id,solution_num) NPZ products may contain source identifiers and coordinates under work/. They are machine-only provenance and are not copied to scientific result outputs.

source_state_rules.gaia_unresolved_machine_bank: The frozen per-(scan_id,solution_num) NPZ caches already bank every strict-HQ Gaia-unresolved source. Additionally retain only mutual nearest-neighbour Gaia-unresolved cross-side pair incidences <=60 arcsec under work/ as a gzip CSV for reproducibility. No source ID or coordinate may appear in result outputs or console summaries.
source_state_rules.interpretation_same_gaia: Persistent reference-object evidence for the isolated-transient branch. Do not delete it from a future variability/flare branch.
source_state_rules.same_gaia_identity: A Gaia EDR3 ID represented by >=1 strict-HQ source in the common footprint on both science sides. Count unique Gaia identities, not Cartesian row pairs.
source_state_rules.source_reuse: Measure unique-source and repeated-source incidence counts across opportunities so repeated use of the same plate/source cannot inflate the scientific denominator unnoticed.

stop_rule: STOP after aggregate strict-HQ source-state census. Interpret Gaia-resolved persistence, Gaia-unresolved close-pair geometry, source reuse, zero-HQ opportunities and site-pair concentration before any candidate inspection, pixel work, registration, or physical parallax pairing.
